title: The Keys To The Keys of The Kingdom Part 2
paragraphs: That was his announcement. It's not that he's coming, he's already arrived. So he was really showing us that the Kingdom of God already exists on Earth. When he arrived, he brought it with him. What is the Kingdom? The Kingdom of God is God's sovereignty and ruling influence on Earth. In other words, heaven is God's domain. It is where the throne of God is located. The throne means the place of power and authority. There, God's government resides.

The Kingdom of God means the influence or power of that Kingdom over the territory. This is the kingdom. The word " dom" is derived from the word " dominion". The word " king" means ruler. So the kingdom means the ruler who controls a territory. So when Christ says repent, in Matthew 4:17, he says repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand. He meant to say, " Change your way of thinking."

Repentance means changing your mind because the Kingdom, that is, the influence of God's sovereignty in this domain, has come to Earth. So he's here. He brought it back, and I use the word "brought it back" because it was here in the Garden of Eden before Adam lost it. And now. Jesus said to the disciples, "The kingdom of God is with you, and will be within you." We will study this later to see how important this concept is. But he was telling them that he was among them.

Then he began to practice the work of the Kingdom in God's sovereignty over the earth. Then he makes a vital and fundamental statement for understanding the Kingdom of God. It is found in the Gospel of Matthew. Let's read this verse again. The verse in Matthew 16:19 says, Christ is speaking. He said, " I will give you the keys," and there is the plural form, the kingdom of heaven, not to but for. One more reminder. He says, " I will give you the keys." There are many different keys to it. Good?

There is not just one key. There are many keys. The preposition does not mean "to". It means a lot of exploration. It's like moving into a house with many rooms. All rooms are locked. So, if you get one key to enter the house, you don't have the keys to the rooms. Having the keys to something means you have the keys to enter all the rooms. Christ says that the kingdom of God is like a house. It is a large house that includes all these different rooms with everything you need.

The Bible says that your Father was pleased to give you the kingdom. But in order to enter the rooms, he says you must know some keys. We all know that the following statements refer to the power of those keys. What does the following statement say? Whatever you bind on earth, whatever you close on earth, heaven closes. Whatever you resolve or open on Earth, Heaven will resolve or open.

He says that the way the Kingdom of God works is, and I'm still trying to grasp this, that all of Heaven, Lord have mercy, everything in Heaven is available to you on Earth. But you are the one who determines how he gets here. Isn't this amazing? So, keys represent some things, and we talked about them this morning. I think it might be helpful to reinforce that briefly. The key to all keys is knowledge. Let me introduce you to the keys. Write this down if you are not here this morning.

Ah, the keys are systems, principles, and laws that operate or are in effect in the kingdom of God. Every government has principles and laws by which it operates. And the kingdom of God is no different. So when Christ says, " I will give you the keys to the kingdom," he is saying, " I will give you commandments and principles." I will give you rules to use in order for certain things to be accomplished for you in the Kingdom of God.

Therefore, the most important thing in life is to know the laws or principles in order to apply and use them. So, what is the key to the keys of the Kingdom? Knowing the truth. This is extremely important. The key to the keys of the Kingdom is knowing the truth. Ah, let me go back for a moment.
